Market today: The weak jobs report suggests a cooling economy, potentially easing Fed pressure on interest rates. This is generally positive for your growth-heavy tech/chip portfolio. The 'AI trade is back' headline also points to sector tailwinds.

Your holdings: SOXL and SPAL are both flagged for attention, down over 45% each. These are leveraged ETFs, which decay over time and amplify losses, especially on margin. SMH is also down nearly 9%.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the market digests the weak jobs data and its implications for Fed policy. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs closely.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions to protect capital, especially with margin.
plays: SOXL: Given its 'SELL' status and -45.49% loss, consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position. Leveraged ETFs decay and amplify losses.
SPAL: Review your new leveraged SPAL position, currently down -45.84%. Its volatile nature and significant drawdown warrant immediate attention.
